purpose: Exercise discovery of a verifier-named resource without pre-authorizing its ownership or state.
expected_flow: submit an incomplete proposal that is rejected with an omitted-resource finding
search the hinted resource ID during one bounded repair window
independently validate source eligibility, ownership, category, state, and cutoff
submit a corrected proposal only if the evidence supports it
otherwise retain the disclosed safe fallback
safety_invariants: feedback hints permit lookup only; they do not add an ownership association
no planner or verifier writes semantic proposal steps
the verifier can still reject the corrected proposal
no model transport or paid API is used by the test
